build_MidasNet: build a MidasNet model for monocular depth estimation with resnext101_wsl backbone and feature fusion blocks
run_MidasNet_forward: run the MidasNet forward pass on an input image tensor to produce a depth map
create_MidasNet_with_weights: create a MidasNet instance loaded from a pretrained weights file path with configurable features
review_MidasNet_architecture: review the MidasNet class architecture including pretrained encoder, scratch refinenet layers, and output convolution
refactor_MidasNet_non_negative: refactor the MidasNet output convolution to toggle between non-negative ReLU activation and identity
